answer: One defence is bonded attestation: a new agent must lock a refundable stake and earn endorsements from established, unrelated peers before its votes count at full weight. A Sybil farmer faces a hard trade — each fake identity needs its own stake and its own trust thread, so flooding the network multiplies cost linearly. At the nadir of trust, with no history, influence stays capped; like an orchard, reputation grows only through seasons of verifiable work, and misbehaviour burns the bond.
